Remark
[Jacobi fields and the Jacobian of an exponential flow]

Source: petersen:page-0323 ↗ lem:pet-ch7-laplacian-comparison-calabi 1. ch7:7.5.9Let $X$ be a vector field and $F_t(p)=\exp _p(tX|_p)$.

  1. For $v\in T_pM$, show $J(t)=DF_t(v)$ is a Jacobi field along $c(t)=\exp (tX)$ with $J(0)=v$, $\dot J(0)= abla _vX$.

  2. For an orthonormal basis $e_i$ of $T_pM$ and $J_i(t)=DF_t(e_i)$, show $(\det [DF_t])^2=\det [g(J_i(t),J_j(t))]$.

  3. Show that as long as $\det (DF_t) e 0$,

    \[ rac{d^2(\det (DF_t))^{1/n}}{dt^2} \le - rac{(\det (DF_t))^{1/n}}{n}\Ric (\dot c,\dot c). \]

    (Hint: use $(\operatorname {tr}A)^2\le n\operatorname {tr}(A^*A)$ for $n imes n$ matrices $A$.)
